name: alt_flow_geometry_inference_gross9_marginal_battery

prior_family_boundary.source_axis: completed-hour price-free taker flow and activity for six Binance USD-M alt perpetuals

retired_rule_families.forbidden_repair: centrality network, quiet-crowd gate, q75 strength, fixed central-flow side
flow/premium discordant tails, consensus votes, fixed 8h side rule
mean-ticket leader gap, q90 leader flow, bottom-four quiet gate

prior_family_boundary.material_difference: AFGI-12 uses no directed centrality, premium input, tail-vote rule, mean-ticket feature, symbolic event threshold, or repaired side. It is one supervised geometry learner over flow, quote volume, and trade count.
prior_family_boundary.terminal_stop: If no AFGI-12 portfolio cell passes, close the six-alt hourly flow/activity supervised-model family. No feature subset, target, quantile, hold, learner, seed, coordination, or threshold repair may reopen it.

hypothesis: Cross-sectional alt-perpetual aggressive-flow geometry may reveal rotation, crowd concentration, and liquidity synchronization before those states are fully transmitted to BTC. A shallow expanding ensemble may rank a sparse bidirectional 12h sleeve that improves frozen Gross9 at identical configured gross.

source_contract.feature_clock: Each source hour [H-1h,H) is usable at H. The model signal is attached to the BTCUSDT 5m bar opening at H; one complete 5m latency bucket is then left empty and entry is the BTCUSDT open at H+5m.
source_contract.invalid_policy: All six symbols must be feature_valid and finite. Missing/invalid rows remain NaN; no carry, interpolation, zero fill, or stale fallback is allowed.
source_contract.outcome_isolation: The feature builder reads no BTC price, return, funding, PnL, Gross9 state, model label, 2025, or 2026 value.

symbol_features.flow_mean_6h: arithmetic mean of the current and preceding five completed valid hours; rolling window includes current; min_periods=6
symbol_features.flow_mean_24h: arithmetic mean of current and preceding 23 completed valid hours; rolling window includes current; min_periods=24
symbol_features.quote_volume_z720: (current quote_volume_usdt - strictly-prior rolling q50)/(strictly-prior (q75-q25)/1.349), using shift(1), 720 positional hours, min_periods=672, linear quantiles
symbol_features.trade_count_z720: same robust-z contract applied to current trade_count
symbol_features.zero_scale: A zero, negative, or non-finite robust scale invalidates the row.

cross_sectional_features.mean_std: population mean and population std (ddof=0) across the six declared symbols
cross_sectional_features.breadth: mean(sign(value)) across six symbols; exact zero contributes zero
cross_sectional_features.abs_hhi: sum((abs(flow_i)/sum_j abs(flow_j))**2); zero/non-finite denominator invalidates the row
cross_sectional_features.alignment: population Pearson correlation across six symbols between current flow and current robust-z activity vector; zero/non-finite population std invalidates the row
cross_sectional_features.rotation_cosine: dot(flow_mean_6h,flow_mean_24h)/(L2 norms product); zero/non-finite norm invalidates the row

pca_geometry.reference: For each current hour t, correlation uses exactly the 168 immediately preceding completed flow vectors [t-168h,t), excludes current t, and requires every value finite.
pca_geometry.eigendecomposition: np.linalg.eigh(float64 correlation); sort eigenvalues descending; clip tiny negative eigenvalues to zero; nonpositive/nonfinite trace invalidates the row.
pca_geometry.pc1_orientation: Orient the leading eigenvector so its loading sum is positive. If abs(sum)<=1e-12, orient the first symbol in frozen order among maximum-absolute loadings positive.
pca_geometry.pc1_variance_share: largest clipped eigenvalue / sum clipped eigenvalues
pca_geometry.effective_rank: exp(-sum(p_i*log(p_i))) over positive normalized clipped eigenvalues
pca_geometry.projections: dot(oriented PC1,current flow) and dot(oriented PC1,current 6h flow mean)
pca_geometry.subspace_drift: 1-abs(dot(v_t,v_(t-1))); both PC1 states are independently prior-only; the first valid state remains invalid for drift

feature_contract.row_admission: All 52 values must be finite at the completed signal hour.

learner_contract.target: Four-output no-stop target: long exact net return, long strict adverse drawdown, short exact net return, short strict adverse drawdown over the fixed 12h path.
learner_contract.target_accounting: Entry/exit cost and exact realized BTCUSDT funding use the same 0.5x multiplicative ExecutionEngine convention as frozen Gross9. Funding timestamps in [entry,exit] are included. Adverse is the favorable-then-adverse strict excursion used by equity_stats: entry cost, favorable price envelope, funding-debit factor, adverse price envelope, then terminal marked result.
learner_contract.score: For each seed and side compute predicted return - 0.5*predicted adverse. Per side score is seed mean - 0.5*population seed std. Choose long on ties; chosen score is the larger side score.
learner_contract.score_threshold: max(0, np.quantile(all finite immediately-prior OOS fold scores,0.95,method='linear')). Admission uses >= before coordination and non-overlap.
learner_contract.fit_purge: A label may enter a fit only when signal, H+5m entry, all 144 held bars, exact funding path, and time exit are strictly before fit_end_exclusive.
learner_contract.stress_replay: 10bp stress reuses identical source features, fitted models, scores, thresholds, sides, coordination masks, and executable schedules. It changes only candidate entry/exit cost; it cannot refit or rescore.

coordination_modes.name: gross9_flat_at_signal
coordination_modes.rule: Frozen Gross9 has no occupied sleeve at completed signal bar.

coordination_modes.name: gross9_drawdown_ge_5pct
coordination_modes.rule: Continuous frozen Gross9 closing equity is at least 5% below its upper-envelope HWM at signal bar; state does not reset at 2024.

execution_and_accounting.entry_exit: Feature available H; signal on BTC bar H; entry H+5m open; hold exactly 144 five-minute bars; exit H+12h+5m open.
execution_and_accounting.nonoverlap: One candidate sleeve. After an accepted entry, later signals through the exact exit position are suppressed; next signal must be exit_position+1 or later.
execution_and_accounting.split_containment: Signal, entry, every held/funding mark, and exit must be contained in the measured calendar window.
execution_and_accounting.portfolio_clock: Candidate path is produced with the funding-aware subaccount path and converted onto the same BTC 5m return/low/high arrays as Gross9.
execution_and_accounting.calendar_metrics: Absolute return, CAGR, strict MDD, and idle time use the complete declared start/end calendar.
execution_and_accounting.strict_mdd: Same-BTC synchronized upper-before-lower envelope, global/pre-entry HWM, entry/exit costs, exact funding factor, every held OHLC bar, and terminal exit are included.

same_gross_formula.combined_candidate: Keep frozen Gross9 weights b_i (sum 9) and add candidate weight c; configured gross=9+c.
same_gross_formula.prorata_control: Use Gross9 only at b_i*(9+c)/9; configured gross=9+c.
same_gross_formula.ratio_comparison: Combined candidate CAGR/strict-MDD minus same-gross pro-rata control CAGR/strict-MDD.
same_gross_formula.retention_and_mdd_comparison: Absolute-return retention and MDD reduction compare combined candidate with unscaled Gross9, not the pro-rata control.
same_gross_formula.gross_interpretation: Static configured sleeve gross, not barwise active exposure.

selection_contract.prior_family_overlap: Report exact-entry Jaccard and +/-12h bidirectional containment versus FCIR-12, DTAC-8, and TGR-12 clocks. These are diagnostic only and cannot select, repair, or reject a cell.
ranking_key: signed geometric mean same-gross improvement desc
minimum stressed standalone absolute return desc
selection_contract.numeric_precision: All selection uses unrounded float64 values; display rounding never enters a gate.

future_veto_contract.research_contamination: 2025/2026 BTC outcomes were inspected elsewhere and can only veto the frozen top1.
